title: refraction
alt: Pecahan cahaya hijau, biru, dan amber membelok melalui prisma kaca di ruang teal gelap
concept: A striking abstract macro optical artwork on a dark petrol-teal ground. A single off-center translucent glass wedge bends a narrow white beam into separated emerald, cyan, pale amber and restrained magenta caustics. Refracted light appears displaced across crisp diagonal planes; softly iridescent edges, luminous colored shadows and deep clean negative space. Elegant tactile optical-glass photography, cinematic but abstract, cover-worthy and legible at thumbnail size. No literal room, no typography, no graphite, no charcoal, no beige handmade-paper collage, no spiral.
